about.title: About me
about.body: Hi, I'm Neha Sahajwani, a Biotechnology undergraduate from India! Growing up with literature, photography and art but choosing a scientific field has inevitably led me to want a combination for both. Here's my portfolio vulnerably displaying the creative side of me with a sprinkle of the science bug! Primarily focused on photography and videography with a side of illustrations, animations and literature.
